The Artisan's Consortium (or the Consortium) is an organization associated with professions. Founded by the vulpera Aisha, the company is a collection of entrepreneurs, artisans, adventurers, and merchants who provide goods and services to crafters and gatherers in need across Azeroth. They have a vast network of artisans and gatherers of all professions that can craft and obtain the highest quality goods, and their business connects those artisans and gatherers to the customers. According to Haephesta, the company is not just a business, they are an innovation on the market. In , the agents and vendors met by the heroes are part of the Dragon Isles branch of the organization.

Arsenal: Undermine Weaponry can be purchased for 4,000 Resonance Crystals from Reno Jackson at the Delver's Headquarters in Dornogal. During The War Within Season 3, this item can be purchased for 5,000 Undercoin from Sir Finley Mrrgglton.
Arsenal: Verdant Gladiator's Weapons are sold by Calderax in Valdrakken for 80 Mark of Honor.
Arsenal: Verdant Aspirant's Weapons are sold by Seltherex in Valdrakken for 80 Mark of Honor.
Arsenal: Obsidian Gladiator's Weapons are sold by Calderax in Valdrakken for 80 Mark of Honor.
Arsenal: Obsidian Aspirant's Weapons are sold by Seltherex in Valdrakken for 80 Mark of Honor.
Ascendants of the Deeps are elemental ascendants that can be found inside L'ghorek in the Abyssal Depths. They drop no loot.

Arsenal: Weathered Twilight's Hammer Armaments can be purchased from Materialist Ophinell for 40 Twilight's Blade Insignia. Following the end of the event on 3 March 2026, it can be purchased from the vendor for 400 Resonance Crystals for a limited-time until 17 March, the start of Midnight Season 1.
Artisan Beverage Goblet Bobber is sold by Blair Bass in the Undermine for 5 "Gold" Fish.
Artisan's Caches are located around throughout the Isle of Quel'Danas during the assault by the Devouring Host. They contain Healing Salve (Isle of Quel'Danas).

Artisan's Ledger is a finishing crafting reagent that increases crafting skill by 10 while crafting most items from any Midnight profession. It can be obtained by fulfilling Crafting Orders or it can be looted from Artisan's Consortium Payout. It can be obtained by fulfilling Crafting Orders, opening an Artisan's Consortium Payout, or by combining 5 Apprentice's Scribbles]. 5 of them can be combined to form a Mentor's Helpful Handiwork.

Artisan Alchemist's Moxie is obtained by gaining Midnight Alchemy Knowledge (5 moxie per knowledge point) and completing patron orders that offer it as a reward (30 moxie per order). It is used to purchase Midnight Alchemy recipes and knowledge books.

Artisan Blacksmith's Moxie is obtained by gaining Midnight Blacksmithing Knowledge (5 moxie per knowledge point) and completing patron orders that offer it as a reward (30 moxie per order). It is used to purchase Midnight Blacksmithing recipes and knowledge books.

Artisan Enchanter's Moxie is obtained by gaining Midnight Enchanting Knowledge (5 moxie per knowledge point) and completing patron orders that offer it as a reward (30 moxie per order). It is used to purchase Midnight Enchanting recipes and knowledge books.

Ascendant Voidcore is created by combining five Ascendant Voidshard. It applies the Ascendant Voidforged: Hero/Myth tag to the item. To be able to start collecting voidshards to craft this item, the Voidforge and Ascendant Nilhammer must be unlocked.

Artisan Engineer's Moxie is obtained by gaining Midnight Engineering Knowledge (5 moxie per knowledge point) and completing patron orders that offer it as a reward (30 moxie per order). It is used to purchase Midnight Engineering recipes and knowledge books.
Artisan Herbalist's Moxie is obtained by gaining Midnight Herbalism Knowledge (5 moxie per knowledge point). It is used to purchase Midnight Herbalism knowledge books and bags full of Midnight herbs.

Artisan Scribe's Moxie is obtained by gaining Midnight Inscription Knowledge (5 moxie per knowledge point) and completing patron orders that offer it as a reward (30 moxie per order). It is used to purchase Midnight Inscription recipes and knowledge books.

Artisan Jewelcrafter's Moxie is obtained by gaining Midnight Jewelcrafting Knowledge (5 moxie per knowledge point) and completing patron orders that offer it as a reward (30 moxie per order). It is used to purchase Midnight Jewelcrafting recipes and knowledge books.

Artisan Leatherworker's Moxie is obtained by gaining Midnight Leatherworking Knowledge (5 moxie per knowledge point) and completing patron orders that offer it as a reward (30 moxie per order). It is used to purchase Midnight Leatherworking recipes and knowledge books.
